entwurf.beschreibung: A quick, humorous walk‑through showing how absolute beginners can install Claude Code, generate a hello‑world script, and verify it, while highlighting the tool’s limits.

teile.name: Hook
teile.suche: Claude Code install, AI coding beginner
teile.text: Ever tried writing code and ended up staring at a blank screen? Claude Code can jump‑start your first function.
teile.szene: A tired student sits at a cluttered desk, coffee steaming, terminal open, blinking cursor awaiting a first line of code.
teile.bildtext: Student at desk with coffee and terminal

teile.name: Install
teile.suche: Claude CLI download, install Claude Code
teile.text: Open your terminal, run the install command from Claude’s site, and watch the silent download finish without any pop‑ups.
teile.szene: The screen shows a single line echoing the download, while the user leans back, wondering if it ever really started.

teile.name: First Prompt
teile.suche: Claude hello world example, AI code generation
teile.text: Launch Claude, type a simple request like “create a hello‑world script,” and it writes the file instantly.
teile.szene: The terminal prints a new file name, then displays the hello‑world code, as the user grins at the magic.

teile.name: Limitation
teile.suche: Claude code execution limit, run generated code
teile.text: Claude can’t run code on its own; you must execute the script locally to see if it works.
teile.szene: The user hits enter, and the console returns a syntax error, reminding them that AI isn’t a compiler.

teile.name: Verification
teile.suche: verify AI generated code, test Claude script
teile.text: Copy the script into your IDE, run a test, and compare output with Claude’s description to confirm accuracy.
teile.szene: In a bright IDE, the code executes cleanly, a green check appears, and the learner sighs in relief.

teile.name: CTA
teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: The presenter winks, pointing at a floating CTA banner in a stylized urban‑poster backdrop.
